title: CORE-6999 · SHARED: final-content→footer gap — VERIFIED, premise wrong, needs re-scope
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-6999](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-6999)

**Verification report:** `reports/T25-CORE-6999-verification.md`

## The premise is materially wrong — no code was written

Not 20px, not tighter at most widths, and **not SHARED**. It affects **8 legal/policy pages out of 92**.
Metric: last section's *content-box* bottom → `footer.top`, measured live vs a local production build.

| 1800 | 1590 | 1440 | 1024 | 768 | 360 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 130/116 = **-14** | 130/100 = **-30** | 95/100 = +5 | 95/100 = +5 | 50/64 = +14 | 50/56 = +6 |

Below 1440 the clone is **looser**, not tighter. The headline "~20px" reproduces on exactly one page
(`/privacy-policy` @1800), and 8 of those 22px come from a separate `<ol>` margin defect.

**Worse than first reported:** the 1590-1799 band is **-30px**, not -14 — confirmed at 1590, 1600,
1680 and 1728 (the default logical width of a 16" MacBook Pro). The clone's `--section-spacing-l`
steps up at 1800 while live's rhythm steps at 1023 and 1590.

8 control pages measured at 48/48 cells: **0px difference**.

## The correct value is proved, but is not reachable from code

Swapping the trailing section's `pb-[var(--section-spacing-l)]` for `responsiveGap.section`
(`pb-0 mb-[50px] min-[1023px]:mb-[75px] min-[1590px]:mb-[110px]`) at runtime gives **48/48 exact
matches** to live. But that value lives entirely in **CMS data**: all 8 documents explicitly store
`{"paddingBottom":"l","gap":"inherit"}`. Editing `TextContent/config.ts` moves zero pixels — Payload
applies a config default only at document creation. There is no git-tracked data route either (no
`src/migrations/`, no `payload migrate` in CI, and the `/next/seed` route no longer exists).

Every code path that *would* move pixels regresses a shared component — e.g. a `gap:'inherit' -> 'section'`
render fallback would also fire on `renewals` block 2/7, which currently matches live at 0px.

## Recommended disposition

1. **Re-title off SHARED** → 8 of 92 pages; -30 @1590-1799, -14 @>=1800, +5/+14/+6 below.
2. **Convert to a CMS content edit**: on each of the 8 pages, on the **last** (`textContent`) block only,
   set Padding bottom `L -> None` and Gap `Inherit -> Section`. Leave the 9 mid-page instances alone.
3. **Separate code task** for the latent default (`TextContent/config.ts:44-47`, `LegacyContent/config.ts:87`)
   — prevention only, moves no pixels today.
4. Separate tickets: the `<ol>` `!mb-0` defect, and FAQs-as-trailing-section on `/compare-packages`
   (+30…+90, opposite sign).

Data change deliberately NOT applied: `MONGODB_URI` is one shared Atlas cluster used by every worktree
and by the deploy, and this is shared content needing a human's go-ahead.
acceptanceCriteria: Ticket re-scoped in Linear off SHARED to the 8 legal/policy pages.
CMS edit applied to the last textContent block on those 8 pages only (paddingBottom L->None, gap Inherit->Section).
Mid-page textContent instances left untouched — verified no regression on the 8 control pages.
Follow-up tickets filed: config default, <ol> margin, FAQs-as-trailing-section.
